bullets.text: Motorola Edge 70 Launches - **Motorola**'s ultra-thin smartphone now available in the UK at €799.
iOS 26.2 Removes Feature - **Apple** will disable Wi-Fi syncing between iPhones and Apple Watches in the EU.
Apple's Christmas Competition - **Apple** invites UK iPad users to submit Christmas tree drawings for a London projection.
AirPods Live Translation - **Apple** confirms the Live Translation feature for AirPods will launch in the EU next month.
New Reminders Feature - **Apple**'s iOS 26.2 introduces 'Urgent' alarms in the Reminders app.
Verizon's Affordable Internet - **Verizon** launches a $25/month internet plan aimed at low-cost connectivity.
Discord Family Center Update - **Discord** enhances parental controls, allowing guardians to monitor teen purchases.
Pinterest Embraces Open Source AI - **Pinterest** CEO highlights open source AI's potential for cost-effective visual AI solutions.
Apple's Siri Overhaul - **Apple** nears a $1 billion deal with **Google** to power a new version of Siri.
Tinder's AI Features - **Tinder** plans to use AI to enhance user experience by accessing Camera Roll photos.
